title: Big Globe Compat - Mine Cells
description: This is a datapack that adds compatibility between Big Globe and Mine Cells.
body:
This datapack enables the Mine Cells portals to generate in the overworld of Big Globe's terrain generation.

The overworld portals are able to generate in any biome that is foresty, cold, or plains like.
If you attempt to /locate a portal, you will need to use the namespace from this datapack, which would look like /locate structure bigglobe_minecells:overworld_portal.
